# `network/realm/gate/GatePlanV1.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/gate/GatePlanV1.js`

Fail-closed Realm entry planning over verified identity, content, and policy evidence.

## Classes

### `class RealmGate`

Runtime Gate evaluator. It owns no persistence and performs no entry itself; it only emits a short-lived signed plan that Shield can enforce.
